learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about Nouns which are special naming words for everything around us!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every person place animal or thing has a name. These naming words are called Nouns. Boy school dog and toy are all nouns!
Some nouns are special names for a specific person or place like Rahul or Delhi. Special names always start with a BIG capital letter.

fun_activity.title: 🔍 Noun Hunt Game
fun_activity.instructions: Look around your room and touch one person one place one animal and one thing. Say their names out loud!

quick_recap: ⭐ A noun is the name of a person place animal or thing.
⭐ Naming words help us know what we are talking about.
⭐ Special names always start with a capital letter.

learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn the magic trick to change one thing into many things!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we have only one thing it is called Singular like one cat. When we have more than one thing it is called Plural like two cats.
To make most words plural we just add a magic S at the end. Book becomes books and pen becomes pens!
Some tricky words need ES at the end to become many. Box becomes boxes and glass becomes glasses.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw One and Many
fun_activity.instructions: Draw one flower on the left side of your paper. Draw three flowers on the right side and write Flowers below them!

quick_recap: ⭐ Plural means more than one thing.
⭐ We add S or ES to make words plural.

learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to use special shortcut words instead of repeating names!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Pronouns are helpful words we use in place of a noun. They stop us from saying the same name again and again.
We use He for a boy or a man. We use She for a girl or a woman. He is reading and She is playing.
We use It when we talk about an animal or a thing. It is a big box. It is a cute dog.

fun_activity.title: 🗣️ Point and Say
fun_activity.instructions: Point to a boy and say He. Point to a girl and say She. Point to a table and say It!

quick_recap: ⭐ Pronouns take the place of nouns.
⭐ He is for boys and She is for girls.
⭐ It is used for animals and things.

learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn all about fun action words that show what we are doing!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Verbs are doing words or action words. They tell us what a person animal or thing is doing.
Words like run jump play eat and sleep are all verbs because they are actions we can do with our body.

fun_activity.title: 🎶 Simon Says Actions
fun_activity.instructions: Ask an elder to play Simon Says. When they say Simon says jump you must do the jump action word!

quick_recap: ⭐ Verbs are also called action words.
⭐ Any work or action we do is a verb.
⭐ Jump sing and dance are fun verbs.

learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn magical describing words that make our sentences colorful and exciting!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Adjectives are words that describe a noun. They tell us how something looks feels tastes or sounds.
Words like red big small soft and sweet are all adjectives. A red apple and a big elephant!

fun_activity.title: 🧸 Describe Your Toy
fun_activity.instructions: Hold your favorite toy. Tell your mom or dad two adjectives about it like It is soft and It is brown.

quick_recap: ⭐ They give us more information about nouns.
⭐ Colors sizes and feelings are all adjectives.

learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn when to use the three special pointing words A, An, and The!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We use A before words that start with a consonant sound. We say a cat and a ball.
We use An before words that start with a magic vowel sound A E I O U. We say an apple and an umbrella.
We use The when we talk about a specific or very special thing. The Sun is bright and The sky is blue.

fun_activity.title: 🎯 A or An Game
fun_activity.instructions: Write five words on paper like egg bat ant dog and owl. Put A or An correctly in front of each word!

quick_recap: ⭐ The is used for special or specific things.
